module_node_type.description: Tree-sitter root node type (e.g. 'module' for Python, 'source_file' for Solidity).

dependency_paths.description: Directory names pruned during the initial repo walk (Phase 3 uses these too).

exclude_parent_field.description: Skip when this node sits in the named field of a given parent type (e.g. 'function_definition.name').

name_field.description: If the function expression has its own name field (e.g. emit_statement.name), use that instead.

write_when_parent_field.description: Reference is a write when the node sits in this parent field (e.g. 'assignment.left').

imports.description: Phase 3: which AST nodes are imports. The actual extraction logic is per-language Python code in core/heuristic_resolver.py — this block lists the node types so the resolver knows what to look for.

external_prefixes.description: Path prefixes that classify an import as external (e.g. '@' for npm scoped packages).

inheritance.description: How contract/class inheritance is shaped in the AST. Two variants supported: Solidity-style (multiple specifier children) and Python-style (single field pointing at a list-like node).

parent_node_types.description: AST node types that can declare bases (e.g. 'contract_declaration', 'class_definition').

child_node_type.description: Solidity-style: parent has multiple direct children of this type, each holding one base.

child_name_field.description: Solidity-style: field on `child_node_type` whose subtree resolves to the base identifier.

bases_field.description: Python-style: field on `parent_node_type` pointing at a list-like node whose identifier children are the bases.
